title: Farm Days Out: Petting Farms and Pick-Your-Own
description: Farm days out with kids: petting farms, farm parks with play barns, lambing season, pick-your-own strawberries and pumpkins, plus hygiene tips.
intro: Bottle-feeding lambs, tractor rides and picking your own strawberries. Farm days out are perfect for little ones and surprisingly fun for big ones too.

image.alt: A girl standing beside sheep at a farm

blocks.title: Scout’s farm verdict
blocks.text: Wash hands with soap and water after touching animals (gel isn’t enough) and before eating. Spring lambing and autumn pumpkins are the highlights.

sections.html: Farm animals can carry germs, so wash hands thoroughly with soap and water after touching animals and before eating, and supervise young children closely. Read pumpkin picking and toddler days out.

faqs.a: Many UK farm parks have lambs in spring, typically from around February to April. Check with the farm, as it varies.
